portability_objective: Preserve deterministic reconstructability of public DNS and edge intent without making one registrar, authoritative-DNS provider, CDN, tunnel vendor, Pages host, or certificate edge the sole continuity prerequisite.

required_records.name: stegverse.org
required_records.intent: Serve the canonical Site from an admissible publication origin selected independently of DNS provider identity.

compatibility_aliases.name: stegverse.ai
compatibility_aliases.intent: Compatibility redirect/alias to canonical stegverse.org when retained.

inputs: current registrar access through its normal external interoperability path
current authoritative-DNS account only when it remains the selected provider
steps: verify canonical domain identity and CNAME repository binding
choose an admissible authoritative-DNS provider without changing canonical Site state
materialize the provider-neutral RRset intent into provider-specific records
verify canonical Site content through the new edge/origin
verify stegverse.ai compatibility redirect only if that alias remains selected
record provider, nameserver, record, TLS, and public-observation evidence
only then retire the previous provider path
recovery_contract.rollback: Restore the prior observed DNS/edge configuration from retained evidence if the replacement fails before cutover completion.

remaining_proof: capture exact current registrar and authoritative nameserver observations
materialize a provider-specific export from this provider-neutral intent
perform and record a controlled DNS/edge migration or equivalent recovery drill
record public content equivalence after cutover
